课程简介（中文）

在中国成功创业，既需把握商机，更需构筑法律坚盾。创业先锋如果缺乏法律坚盾和防范意识，在长期商业竞赛中不仅难以守护创新成果，更可能使其全部心血付诸东流。在创业腾飞之前，必须配备完善的风险缓释机制。本课程聚焦运用法律工具为商业活动保驾护航，结合真实案例，从初创企业视角，系统审视商业全周期。涵盖：市场准入、企业设立、IP 运营、以及合规管理等

课程简介（英文）

How to make money in China? How to avoid to losing money within China? While the first issue suits business schools, the latter is a typical law school issue. However, this course, Legal Aspects of Start-ups Doing Business in China, stands up in between, in the belief that without the helmet and shield from the legal premise, a business pioneer would risk all the efforts of his innovations, products and business models in the long-term race, not to mention safeguarding his harvest from such business. A proper parachute is instantly and constantly necessary before the entrepreneurship soars high into blue sky.This course applies PEST and SWOT analyses, as well as case-study methods, in the POV of a start-up, to walk the students through the whole business-life, including but not limited to soft-landing phase, the formation of business, the transaction rules, the legal compliance of routine operations, and the dispute resolutions.

 

教学目标

This course aims to walk you through the current legal environment of China, its origin, logic, structure, and evolution, hence fostering a deep understanding and practice in real-life scenarios, upon the issue of start-ups conducting better businesses in China.

The main goals of this course lie in three sectors:

  • To provide the in-person academic teaching and coaching experience, a completion of a 2-credit course.
  • To provide the international students a framework to equip, a toolkit to find, an in-depth observation of cross-cultural businesses, with theiron-hand business blueprints or business extension plans throughout China, if any.

Local students are also welcome to attend, though this course’s focus is for the international students; however, from an unusual perspective, to dive deep and understand the Chinese legal environment may also be beneficial for their future careers.

教学方式

  • This course begins with challenging issues faced by start-ups doing business in China and provides an in-depth survey of Chinese Legal Tradition & Legal Philosophy, grounded in a historical and cultural analysis. The course will aid the internationawith l students with a better understanding of Chinese legal culture as part of business.     Doctrine and hermeneutics, as well as case analysis, will be applied in each part of the course. While the field trip(s) are mainly arranged as extracurricular activities, this course encourages all the students participate in such activities.  

教学内容与进度安排

Episode 1 Introduction to China’s Legal Tradition

  • Formation of China’s Legal Tradition
  • Impacts of Chinese Legalism
  • Ruling Party in reign, some red flags
  • Legal Structure

Episode 2 Legal Philosophy

  • rule of law v. rule by law, white cat/black cat theory
  • Absence & lack of property protection
  • book-stealing is not a crime, etc. IP as a measure for development
  • Chinese-logic of unfair dealing, Deep Seek or Deep-sink?

Episode 3 Global Expansion and Soft-landing for Doing Better Businesses

  • Globalization or localization? Different narratives, same logic
  • How does a start-up to start within China?
  • ‘A man with a why to live with can bear almost anyhow (Fredrick Niches)’, so does a start-up!
  • Case study: Doing Better Business like Tesla Giga Factory

Episode 4 Business Structure

  • Individual
  • Joint venture
  • WOFE
  • But is there pathway to stop bleeding?

Episode 5 Foreign Investment Law

  • Globalization or Anti-globalization? Global Competition! Its impacts and the preparation
  • Elements and principles of Foreign Investment Law

Investment Negative List, Bu

  • siness Environment Optimization and Free-trade zone

Episode 6 Contract Law

  • Governing rules & the connection with CISG
  • Labour contract

Episode 7 Intellectual Property Law

  • Copyright, Patent, Trademark and Trade Secret
  • Case Study: Oliver Palmer’s Smilence on Zotye-SR9
  • Case Study: Tim Cook’s pocket money for more than iPad trademark compensation

Episode 8 Competition Law

  • Illegal Conducts
  • Consumers Protection: general principles & special rules for food and pharmaceutical products
  • Market Dominance is a sweet reward for business effort, but what does Anti-monopoly for start-ups?

Episode 9 Legal Issues of E-commerce

  • Is platform (flat) market fair enough to do business?
  • Safe harbour and red flag doctrine
  • Privacy and Network Security

Episode 10 Compliance, Taxations and Corporate Crimes (optional)

  • Case Study: the closure of Seagate (Suzhou) under taxation inspection (2015~2023)
  • Case Study: GlaxoSmithKline Bribery (2014)

Episode 11 Dispute Resolution

  • Civil/Administrational/Criminal Procedures
  • Arbitration
  • Mediation

Episode 12 Presentations of Ritual & Examination
